note: A gate is complete only when status is 'complete' AND evidence (document ref, signer, date) is filled in. PHI stays blocked until every gate is complete. Edit this file only after the real-world step is done.

gates.title: Signed BAA with Google Cloud covering every service used
BAA (or HIPAA-eligible hosting) for the web host; Vercel BAA needs Enterprise
BAA with any email/notification vendor that could carry PHI
HIPAA Security Rule risk assessment completed and documented
Privacy, security, retention and breach-response policies adopted
MFA enforced and role model in place; orgId claims provisioned server-side
Malware/quarantine scan before uploaded files enter the evidence workflow
Immutable security logging for reads, exports, counsel sharing, binder generation
Firestore and Storage rules deployed and passing emulator negative tests (npm run test:rules)
Healthcare/regulatory attorney review: unauthorized practice of law boundary
Terms of service, privacy policy and attorney-referral model reviewed
PowerGM redacted export/API schema supplied and validated
Written production/PHI authorization after all gates above
